column3: ...Who are you?\nYou don't feel like\nanyone I've met.{end_wait}
Does that frighten you?{end_wait}
It makes me careful.\nWhat do you want?{end_wait}
You know Ash Jenna.\nOr you think you do.{end_wait}
She looks just\nlike Jenna.{end_wait}

The likeness isn't
an accident.{page_break}There are others.
Different faces.
Different reasons.{end_wait}
What do you want\nwith them?{end_wait}
I don't need them\nto obey me.{page_break}They can make their\nown terrible choices.{end_wait}
Have we met before?{end_wait}
Not yet, Isaac.\nNot for a long while.\nThat is the point.{end_wait}

I wanted to see
the original. I'm
curious, that's all.{page_break}You may meet others.
I know them better
than you think.{page_break}Ash Jenna lost everything.
She's cruel, but she's
afraid of being left alone.{page_break}Sarah is searching
for a lost family member.
She won't give up.{page_break}Kegare wore Mia's face
to deceive people.
She wanted friends, too.{page_break}Heart cannot bear
to look at herself.
Her anger grows.{end_wait}

A word at the right
time can change a path.
They choose their own.{page_break}I'll hold back in
our fight. Consider
it a courtesy.{page_break}I don't want to break
you before I know
what you are.{end_wait}
...You're\nunderestimating me.{end_wait}
Perhaps.\nDraw your sword.{end_wait}
Tell me who you are.{end_wait}

You've asked three
times now. That's
three more than most.{page_break}Your friends are free.
I kept my word.{end_wait}
This was only a test,\nIsaac. You passed it.{page_break}Be glad you did not\nneed the rest of me.{end_wait}
A test of what?{end_wait}
Of whether you are\nworth the trouble.{end_wait}

Heart answers to me.
That much is true.{page_break}I'll remind her
whose orders she
carries.{end_wait}
Your orders?{end_wait}
Even a lens needs\nsomeone to point it.{end_wait}
When the Grave Eclipse\ncomes, remember\nthis day.{end_wait}
Thirty years, Isaac.\nI will see you then.{end_wait}
Isaac! I can't move!\nWhat did you do to us?{end_wait}
My Psynergy won't answer.\nShe's holding it back.{end_wait}
She's been waiting for us.\nIsaac, don't believe this\nwas a chance meeting.{end_wait}
Let them go.\nI'm the one you want.{end_wait}
They're unharmed.\nBut they won't interfere.\nThis is between us, Isaac.{page_break}Show me what you can do.{end_wait}
And thirty years?\nWhat did she mean by that?{end_wait}
Are you sending\nthem after me?{end_wait}
Isaac! Are you all right?\nWe couldn't do a thing\nwhile you fought her.{end_wait}
I'm fine.\nAre you three okay?{end_wait}
I am. But she blocked\nmy Psynergy completely.\nHow did she do that?{end_wait}
And those others...\nDo you think she wants\nthem to come for us?{end_wait}
Maybe she doesn't\nneed to do much.\nShe knows what each wants.{end_wait}
Then how long has she\nbeen watching us?{end_wait}
I don't know, Mia.\nI wish I did.{end_wait}
